summaries.Romania: Romania's economy showed unexpected resilience with 2.1% growth in Q3 2026, the second-best in the EU, while political tensions persist over administrative reforms and constitutional court independence. Key debates around the healthcare system, military recruitment, and EU relations dominated the agenda.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation focuses on AI-powered clinical workflows, conflict-of-interest concerns in preventive care policy, and expanded access initiatives, while regulatory changes around Medicaid work requirements and organ donation rules reshape the system.
summaries.Tech: Major outages at Microsoft (365/Outlook) and the FAA dominated infrastructure news, while Nvidia faces leadership crisis with Jensen Huang's departure, and OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet enabling AI agents to make purchases autonomously.

items.title: Eurostat: România a avut a doua cea mai mare creștere economică din UE în trimestrul al treilea, după Irlanda
items.snippet: România a înregistrat a doua cea mai puternică creștere economică din Uniunea Europeană în trimestrul al treilea din 2026, după Irlanda, potrivit estimărilor preliminare publicate vineri de Eurostat. PIB-ul României a avansat cu 2,1% față de trimestrul precedent, în timp ce economia Irlandei a cresc
items.line: Romania's 2.1% Q3 GDP growth—second-best in EU—signals economic stabilization after months of contraction, though industrial production and consumption remain weak.

items.title: STAT+: Enforcement of stringent Medicaid work requirements delayed for six months
items.snippet: Enforcement of the Trump administration's stringent new Medicaid work requirements have been delayed for six months, until July 1, 2027.
items.line: Trump administration delays enforcement of Medicaid work requirements for six months, giving states time to strengthen eligibility systems before July 2027 deadline.

items.title: US government grounds all flights across the United States ‘due to extraordinary circumstances’
items.snippet: A spokesperson for the FAA told TechCrunch that it issued the ground stop "following communication issues impacting multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers," which manage the airspace across the United States.
items.line: FAA grounds all US flights due to communication issues at air traffic control centers, lifting after 4.5 hours—third nationwide ground stop in history.

items.title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
items.snippet: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.
items.line: OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet enables AI agents ('Dots') to autonomously shop and checkout using integrated American Express, Mastercard, and Visa partnerships.

items.title: Microsoft’s global outage may be worse than Amazon's or CrowdStrike's, expert says
items.snippet: Governments, hospitals, courts scrambled by global Microsoft outage.
items.line: Microsoft's 24-hour global 365 outage affecting Outlook, Teams, and cloud services may be worse than Amazon or CrowdStrike incidents, disrupting governments and hospitals.

items.title: Pacienții vor primi notificări la fiecare serviciu medical înregistrat pe CNP-ul lor, anunță ministrul Sănătății
items.snippet: Ministrul Sănătății, Alexandru Rogobete, a anunțat că își dorește implementarea unui sistem prin care pacienții să fie notificați de fiecare dată când este înregistrat un serviciu medical pe codul lor numeric personal. items.line: New notification system for medical services registered on CNP aims to combat fictive billing and improve healthcare transparency and patient oversight.

items.snippet: Liderii europeni reuniți la un summit la Dublin au convenit, vineri, ca Germania, Franța, Italia, Polonia, Regatul Unit și reprezentanții instituțiilor UE să îi reprezinte în discuțiile cu Statele Unite, Rusia și Ucraina, au declarat pentru Reuters patru surse. items.line: Romania to be represented by six countries/institutions in Ukraine peace negotiations—a significant diplomatic win ensuring European voice in geopolitical settlement.

items.line: Nvidia board seeks successor to Jensen Huang amid scandal over alleged extramarital affair and national security concerns tied to China AI competition.

items.title: Zus Health secures $33M to build the infrastructure for AI-powered clinical workflows
items.snippet: As healthcare companies race to build AI copilots and agents, startup Zus Health is betting that the bigger opportunity is creating the connected patient data layer those applications need to work reliably.
items.line: Zus Health raises $33M to build connected patient data infrastructure that enables reliable AI clinical workflows across healthcare systems.

items.title: STAT+: Oura’s acquisition of health tech startup raises conflict-of-interest questions for Eli Lilly, experts say
items.snippet: With a new deal announced this week, the relationship between Eli Lilly and a telehealth company that markets GLP-1s is expected to grow more complicated.
items.line: Eli Lilly faces conflict-of-interest scrutiny as smart-ring maker Oura acquires telehealth startup, complicating GLP-1 marketing relationships.

items.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
items.snippet: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.
items.line: Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia reverberates through AI startup ecosystem as founders and VCs brace for smaller checks and lower valuations without his funding push.

items.title: Bon Secours Mercy Health bumps up offer for majority stake in Surgery Partners to $6B valuation
items.snippet: The updated deal values the short-stay surgical platform at $6 billion and is the latest example of large health systems' push to build out their ambulatory networks.
items.line: Bon Secours Mercy Health raises Surgery Partners valuation to $6B, reflecting major health systems' strategy to build ambulatory surgical networks.
